title: Development of potent and selective CK1α Molecular Glue Degraders
authors: Geng Q; Jiang Z; Byun WS; Donovan KA; Zhuang Z; Jiang F; Jones HM; Razumkov H; Tang MT; Sarott RC; Fischer ES; Corsello SM; Hinshaw SM; Gray NS
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子分子胶降解剂诱导CK1α蛋白降解，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与课题无关。
abstract: Molecular glue degraders (MGDs) are small molecules that facilitate proximity between a target protein and an E3 ubiquitin ligase thereby inducing target protein degradation. Glutarimide-containing compounds are MGDs that bind to cereblon (CRBN) and recruit neosubstrates. Through explorative synthesis of a glutarimide-based library, we discovered a series of molecules that induce casein kinase 1 alpha (CK1α) degradation. By scaffold hopping and rational modification of the chemical scaffold, we identified an imidazo[1,2-a]pyrimidine compound that induces potent and selective CK1α degradation. A structure-activity relationship study of the lead compound, QXG-6442, identified the structural features that contribute to degradation potency and selectivity compared to other frequently observed neosubstrates. The glutarimide library screening and structure activity relationship medicinal chemistry approach we employed is generally useful for developing new molecular glue degraders towards new targets of interest.
abstract_zh: 分子胶降解剂（MGDs）是一类小分子，能够促进靶蛋白与E3泛素连接酶之间的邻近性，从而诱导靶蛋白降解。含戊二酰亚胺的化合物是结合cereblon（CRBN）并招募新底物的MGDs。通过对基于戊二酰亚胺的化合物库进行探索性合成，我们发现了一系列能诱导酪蛋白激酶1α（CK1α）降解的分子。通过骨架跃迁和对化学骨架的合理修饰，我们鉴定出一种咪唑并[1,2-a]嘧啶化合物，它能诱导强效且选择性的CK1α降解。对先导化合物QXG-6442的构效关系研究确定了相较于其他常见新底物，有助于降解效力和选择性的结构特征。我们采用的戊二酰亚胺库筛选及构效关系药物化学方法，对于开发针对新目标的新型分子胶降解剂具有普遍适用性。
